lastText: The Case Is ClosedThe Professor's TermsNew Ending Discovered · 1 / 26A SWISS HOLIDAY: THE DETECTIVE RETURNS ALONEYou come down from the Falls with the Professor's paper in your coat, and a very different idea of what you are. Watson never learns what passed on the path. He is told only that the Professor was not there, and that you changed your mind. You go to Interlaken. In the autumn, a house in Sussex is bought in a name that is not yours. You do not ask where the money came from, and you do not much like the look of your own face in the shaving-glass. He is remembered as a man who knew how to work with others: a Doctor, a Brother, an Inspector, a Boy.
